title: Node Connection State Message
description: MQTT payload for nodes/{node_id}/connection topic. Used for LWT (Last Will and Testament) and online/offline state. Retain=true. Does NOT use the common telemetry envelope.

reason.description: Reason for status change. Optional — broker LWT may omit. connect (normal connect), lwt (broker-published will), timeout (backend timeout detection). Omitted/empty normalized to 'unknown' by backend (#96).

boot_id.description: ULID format boot identifier of the node
